description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the authorization records of a specified knowledge base by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询指定知识库的检索授权记录
name: ListKnowledgeBaseRetrievalGrants

parameters.help_en: The type of the principal that receives the share. This parameter is optional. Default value: USER. Only USER is supported in the initial release
parameters.help_zh: 接收分享的主体类型，可选，省略默认USER；首期仅支持USER
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. This parameter is optional. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，省略默认20，范围1至100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The cursor returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的游标，首次不传
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The business error code. You can use this code to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

KnowledgeBaseRetrievalGrants.description_en: The user authorization relationships on the current page

PrincipalId.description_en: The DataWorks user ID of the principal that receives the share. When a principal is added, the system verifies whether the user is a member of the same tenant
PrincipalId.description_zh: 接收分享的 DataWorks UserId，新增时校验同租户成员

PrincipalType.description_en: The object type of the principal to accept the share. Default value: USER. Only USER is allowed in the initial release
PrincipalType.description_zh: 接收分享的对象类型，省略默认 USER；首期仅允许 USER

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page used in the current request. If you do not specify this parameter in the request, the value is 20. This value is not the actual number of entries returned on the current page
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求采用的每页条数上限；省略入参时为 20，不是本页实际返回条数

NextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. If no subsequent pages exist, null is returned
NextToken.description_zh: 后续页游标；无后续页返回 null

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
